portal_hypertension.title: Photon-counting CT-derived hepatic extracellular volume quantification for noninvasive risk stratification of clinically significant portal hypertension (CSPH): a prospective cohort study.
portal_hypertension.authors: Dell T, Tischler V, Zocholl D
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究（样本量约为 113）。核心观点：评估光子计数 CT (PCCT) 衍生的肝细胞外容量 (ECV) 是否可以作为无创成像生物标志物来检测或排除代偿性晚期慢性肝病患者的临床显着性门静脉高压 (CSPH) 临床提示：评估光子计数 CT (PCCT) 衍生的肝细胞外容量 (ECV) 是否可以作为无创成像生物标志物来检测或排除患有肝病的患者中具有临床意义的门脉高压 (CSPH)。
portal_hypertension.abstract: To evaluate whether photon-counting CT (PCCT)-derived hepatic extracellular volume (ECV) can serve as a noninvasive imaging biomarker to detect or exclude clinically significant portal hypertension (CSPH) in patients with compensated advanced chronic liver disease (cACLD). This prospective single-center study included 113 participants with chronic liver disease who underwent contrast-enhanced liver PCCT between February 2022 and January 2025. Hepatic ECV was calculated from the delayed phase (5 min post-contrast). portal_hypertension.title: Semaglutide therapy for metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis: November 2025 updates to AASLD Practice Guidance.
portal_hypertension.authors: Bansal MB, Patton H, Morgan TR
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于综述研究。核心观点：本实践建议是 2023 年 AASLD 关于非酒精性脂肪性肝病 (NAFLD)（现称为代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病 (MASLD)）临床评估和管理的实践指南的更新，并提供 临床提示：本实践建议是 2023 年 AASLD 实践指南的更新，该指南涉及非酒精性脂肪性肝病 (NAFLD)（现称为代谢功能障碍相关性肝病）的临床评估和管理。
portal_hypertension.abstract: This practice recommendation serves as an update to the 2023 AASLD Practice Guidance on the clinical assessment and management of nonalcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD), now known as metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD), and provides implementable guidance on patient selection for treatment, consideration of comorbidities, and monitoring of treatment safety and efficacy of semaglutide. portal_hypertension.title: Distinctive hemodynamic phenotype in Fontan-type circulation patients with distal esophageal varices.
portal_hypertension.authors: Téllez L, Toledano M, Álvarez M
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：食管静脉曲张 (EV) 在具有 Fontan 型循环的成人中很常见，并且可能通过不同的血流动力学机制出现，具体取决于其解剖位置。 临床提示：我们的目的是确定该人群中 EV 的患病率、解剖分布和血流动力学相关性。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Esophageal varices (EV) are common in adults with Fontan-type circulation and may arise via distinct hemodynamic mechanisms depending on their anatomic location. We aimed to determine the prevalence, anatomical distribution, and hemodynamic correlates of EV in this population. In this prospective cohort study, 114 consecutive adults with Fontan-type circulation underwent combined hepatic and cardiac catheterization, esophagogastroduodenoscopy, and liver biopsy. Patients were classified by endoscopic findings into those with and without EV, and the EV cohort was further stratified by location (proximal or distal). portal_hypertension.title: Post-Transplant liver assessment: Practical applications of non-invasive testing.
portal_hypertension.journal: Liver transplantation : official publication of the American Association for the Study of Liver Diseases and the International Liver Transplantation Society
portal_hypertension.authors: Brujats A, Mendoza YP, Becchetti C
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：肝移植（LT）改变了终末期肝病和肝细胞癌患者的预后，提供了良好的长期生存率。 临床提示：然而，移植后的结果可能会因同种异体移植物排斥和复发性或新发肝病而受到危害，这些肝病可能会进展为移植物纤维化、肝硬化和肝脏相关并发症。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Liver transplantation (LT) has transformed the prognosis of patients with end-stage liver disease and hepatocellular carcinoma, offering excellent long-term survival. However, post-transplant outcomes can be jeopardized by allograft rejection and by recurrent or de novo liver disease, which may progress to graft fibrosis, cirrhosis, and liver-related complications. Non-invasive tests (NITs) have emerged as powerful tools for evaluating steatosis, fibrosis, and portal hypertension in native liver disease, but their optimal role after LT remains uncertain and variably defined. portal_hypertension.title: Development and Validation of an Interpretable Machine Learning Model for Predicting Tumor Recurrence After Microwave Ablation in Small Hepatocellular Carcinoma.
portal_hypertension.authors: Ma Y, Zhao L, Zhao Q
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究（样本量约为 536）。核心观点：准确且可解释的消融后复发风险预测对于个体化监测和管理策略至关重要。 临床提示：本研究旨在开发和验证可解释的机器学习 (IML) 模型，用于预测 sHCC 患者 MWA 后的肿瘤复发。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Tumor recurrence remains a major clinical challenge following microwave ablation (MWA) for small hepatocellular carcinoma (sHCC). Accurate and interpretable prediction of post-ablation recurrence risk is essential for individualized surveillance and management strategies. This study aimed to develop and validate an interpretable machine learning (IML) model for predicting tumor recurrence after MWA in patients with sHCC. This retrospective study included 536 consecutive patients with sHCC treated with ultrasound-guided MWA between July 2017 and July 2023.
